note: FD.75 (edge audit E1 + E2, FD.3c). E1: an env subscript or property ASSIGNED (`os.environ["X"] = v`, `process.env.X = v`, `ENV["X"] = v`) or deleted (`del os.environ["X"]`) is no READS_CONFIG; a compound `+=` and a comparison still read. E2: the generic Vault `.read(` row needs a Vault client named in the file (hvac, node-vault, hashicorp/vault, VaultTemplate, VaultSharp, vaultrs, Ruby `require 'vault'`) where the guard admits it, not the bare word `vault` anywhere (a `Vault.sol` string, a `vault` closure, a comment). Baseline HEAD c4152966: forbid violations 7. Controls: real env reads in the same files and two hvac reads.
